critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1968 lines — split into routers (finance/customers/orders/admin) recommended for maintainability.

finance_update recomputes classification but only propagates amount/currency/date to linked wage; it does NOT re-link when category changes to/from wage or when recipient_employee_id changes on update. Minor: safe for current UI (create-only wage recipient), but PUT could leave stale wage rows if a wage txn's category is edited to non-wage or vice-versa. Consider syncing employee_wages on update (delete+insert when wage-ness/recipient changes).
_compute_balances treats order_revenue as increasing balance even though order-linked revenue may or may not correspond to actual cash-in yet. Not part of this pass but worth reviewing later.
txn-recipient select is intentionally conditional on wage category on the frontend — matches spec; no issue.
AdminFinance.jsx: xfer 'Dari'/'Ke' auto-set opposite is duplicated on both onValueChange handlers; small helper could DRY it.
